hooks.name: Skills Auto-Activate
hooks.description: Automatically activates caveman mode and semantic_reviewer skill at the start of every session.

action.prompt:
Activate the following skills for this session:
1. "caveman" - Communicate in caveman style to reduce token usage while maintaining full technical accuracy.
2. "semantic_reviewer" - Use the semantic reviewer for code change reviews, analyzing at behavioral level organized by concern.
